---
title: "Five-year budget impact of forecast-guided stewardship"
format: html
execute: {echo: true, warning: false}
---

This distinct BIA estimates annual payer expenditure from 2026 to 2030 in constant
2026 euros. It contains no QALY, ICER or willingness-to-pay decision rule.

```{r}
source("R/run_budget_impact_analysis.R")
annual <- read.csv("outputs/budget_impact_r/annual_budget_impact.csv")
summary <- read.csv("outputs/budget_impact_r/five_year_budget_summary.csv")
annual
summary
```

Uptake, setup, operating and variable-cost assumptions are explicit in
`parameters/bia_parameters.csv` and remain illustrative pending jurisdiction-specific
costing.
